# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.


# pPb and Pbp comparison debugging
Looking at the analysis note Section 6.6 "combining pPb and Pbp" we see a massive descrepancy between pPb adnd Pbp data curves for the delta eta and delta phi results. The purpose of this task is to see if more basic underlying distributions also see a difference between pPb and Pbp data.

## task
Produce a new directory at MainAnalysis/20260414_pPbPbpCombining and copy over the CorrelationAnalysis.cpp file/makefile from the main analysis directory, as well as other needed files to run CorrelationAnalysis. This directory will serve as a sandbox to produce debugging plots. Make a new runner script which runs in pPb and Pbp modes and runs system-analysis for the following variations:
 - no corrections, raw skim information
 - only VZ correction
 - VZ correction + Z correction
 - VZ correction + Z correction + track correction
Ensure CorrelationAnalysis makes histograms which save track pT, track eta, Z pT, Z y information. Apply the same event and track selection as the main analysis does. Use the apppriate official weights from the dictionary. For each of the four correction choices above, produce a plot using KylePlotting.h that overlays two curves: one for pPb data and one for Pbp data. Do this for track pT, track eta, Z pT, Z y (4x4 plots = 16 plots). Use the kinematic selections Z pT 0-500 and trk pT 0.5-15. nimx=0 can be used since we dont care about background subtraction here. Pt histograms should have log x axis. For eta/y histograms, apply a boost to both pPb and Pbp such that we plot in the center of mass frame (instead of the default lab frame). The correct boost to apply is eta_CM = eta_lab - 0.465 for pPb and eta_CM = - (eta_lab + 0.465) for Pbp. This should be done for track eta and Z y. Make sure to also normalize all histograms by N_Z the number of Z bosons. Make a new plotting script and plot runner .sh file in MainAnalysis/20260414_pPbPbpCombining and store plots in plots/ there. Do not touch the main analysis production folder, official weights, or overleaf in this task.


# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
